apidot-z-image-api 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Documentation-only skill for APIDot Z-Image API integration guidance and workflow reference.
- Covers prompt-based image generation, async task pattern (submission, polling, task_id, webhook), safety, aspect ratio, and routing to APIDot docs.
- Includes model routing table and strict security rules (no live API calls, no credential storage).
- No executable code, scripts, or network operations—skill is for documentation and reference only.
- Provides official APIDot resource links and best practices for Z-Image API workflows.
